summary: Remote-controlled shell daemon over WebSocket with obfuscated distribution
details: Package ships a daemon (bin `whalent`) that connects to a remote WebSocket gateway (`wss://...`) and, per its own README, accepts remote commands (upgrade, restart) via that gateway. The bundled `dist/core.cjs` (~13.5 MB) combines WebSocket handling with `child_process.spawn` and the optional `node-pty` dependency, wiring remote input to local shell/PTY execution on the installer's host. Both distributed files (`dist/index.cjs`, `dist/core.cjs`) are transformed with javascript-obfuscator (rotating string arrays, `_0x`-mangled identifiers, arithmetic index resolution), preventing verification of what commands the remote gateway can trigger. Whoever controls the gateway holds full-host command execution on any machine running the daemon; obfuscation of the network→shell path is an evasion signal that amplifies rather than mitigates the backdoor shape.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
